name: South America Map Labeling Activity
description:
Create a 3-page interactive geography lesson flipchart about South America.

Your task:
1. Page 1 (Title): Create a title page with the text "South America: Countries and Capitals".

2. Page 2 (Labeled Map): 
   - Import the map image provided at '/home/ga/Pictures/ActivInspire/south_america_map.png' onto the canvas.
   - Add text labels for these 6 countries: Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Peru, Chile, Venezuela.
   - Draw lines or arrows connecting each text label to the correct country on the map.

3. Page 3 (Practice): Create a page titled "Label the Map" that lists the same 6 country names as separate text objects (for students to drag-and-drop later).

4. Save the flipchart to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/south_america_map.flipchart'.

Note: ActivInspire is already running. You can find the map image in the specific folder mentioned above.
